bothy_keeper.text: Welcome to the bothy. A bothy is a simple shelter for walkers, free for anyone to use, and best left tidier than you found it.
The Comeraghs are in County Waterford. Coumshingaun is a corrie, a steep bowl with a lake in it, scooped out by a glacier thousands of years ago.

then.text: Another flask? I need some myself. Off you go, and keep to the path.

else.text: Mahon Falls pours off the plateau too, a long white ribbon. Here, a flask of tea. Walkers have to look after one another.
